'''Nanth'ri''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] found along the [[Nanth'ri Route]]. [[Celis Mott]] hailed from this world.

==History==
Nanth'ri was explored sometime between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] and [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.

Nanth'ri was a stronghold of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Hunt for Zsinj]], which took place between [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] and [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] and the [[Thrawn campaign]] of [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

The planet was [[Battle of the Nanth'ri system|occupied]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] shortly after they arrived in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], Nanth'ri boasted a population of 500 million to 1 billion [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]].<ref name="TEA" />
